name: @leadcommand/action-mcp-server
description: LeadCommand ACTION MCP (phase 1): agents operate LeadCommand ONLY through the one governed Action Gateway (apps/api/src/lib/domain/action-gateway). Loopback Streamable HTTP or stdio; per-agent credentials verified server-side; PostgREST-only under the database-role-enforced lc_action_gateway credential. Everything is born OFF.
x-runtime-note: Runs inside the rei-automation checkout: @/ imports resolve to apps/api/src (the Action Gateway domain module); pg and @supabase/supabase-js resolve from the monorepo root node_modules. Deliberately OUTSIDE the npm workspace globs so the root package-lock (production npm ci) is unchanged. Reuses, without modifying, the read-only server's credential-file, limits, redaction and audit modules (mcp/leadcommand-mcp/src).
